title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory
statusNote: Plays: Gameloft logo, title, main menu, a new single-player game and into the 3D training mission, where Sam moves, jumps, crouches, draws his weapon and switches vision modes. Only the start of the training mission was played.
notes: 5 confirms on the title screen and in every menu; the left soft key selects and the right one goes back.
A new game starts with a training mission in which Redding explains the keys as you go.
In play the left soft key opens the menu (Objectives, Notes, E-mail, Config with Load Game and Quit); the right soft key resumes.
Multiplayer and N-Gage Arena need Bluetooth or the online service and cannot work here.

controls.source: The training mission's own instructions (controller keys move, 2, 4, 6 and 8 position the camera) and its on-screen prompt "7: Interact"; the other keys were observed in the training room. The game has no controls screen. Firing was not tried (the training starts without ammunition).

actions.8: Tilt the camera the other way
actions.1: Draw or put away the weapon (aiming view)
actions.3: Vision mode: normal, night vision, thermal
actions.lsk: Game menu in play; select in menus
actions.rsk: Resume; back in menus (Exit on the main menu)

notes: Third-person layout: move on WASD or the arrows, camera on I, J, K and L, jump on Space, interact on E, weapon on F, crouch on C, vision on V, binoculars on B. On a gamepad the left stick moves, the right stick moves the camera, A jumps, B crouches, X interacts, Y draws the weapon, the bumpers are vision and binoculars, and Start opens the game menu.
